from collections import Counter
def blocks(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cntv=Counter(v for row in g for v in row); bg=cntv.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sr=[i for i in range(H) if len(set(g[i]))==1]; sc=[j for j in range(W) if len({g[i][j] for i in range(H)})==1]
    rr=[-1]+sr+[H]; cc_=[-1]+sc+[W]
    res=[]
    for R0,R1 in zip(rr,rr[1:]):
        for C0,C1 in zip(cc_,cc_[1:]):
            acc=Counter(g[i][j] for i in range(R0,R1) for j in range(C0,C1) if i not in sr and j not in sc)
            nonbg=[(v,c) for v,c in acc.items() if v!=bg]
            if nonbg:
                main=max(nonbg,key=lambda x:x[1])[0]
                S=set((i-R0,j-C0) for i in range(R0,R1) for j in range(C0,C1) if g[i][j]==main and i not in sr and j not in sc)
                res.append((R0,R1,C0,C1,main,len(S),S))
            else:
                res.append((R0,R1,C0,C1,None,0,set()))
    return res

for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    I=G[name+' input']; O=G[name+' output']
    print('====',name)
    for b in blocks(I):
        R0,R1,C0,C1,m,n,S=b
        u=all(O[i][j]==m for i in range(R0,R1) for j in range(C0,C1)) if m else None
        shape=tuple(sorted(S))
        print((R0,R1,C0,C1),'color',m,'n',n,'filled',u,'shape',shape)

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def geom(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cntv=Counter(v for row in g for v in row); bg=cntv.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sr=[i for i in range(H) if len(set(g[i]))==1]; sc=[j for j in range(W) if len({g[i][j] for i in range(H)})==1]
    return bg,sr,sc

def blocks(g):
    bg,sr,sc=geom(g); H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    rr=[-1]+sr+[H]; cc_=[-1]+sc+[W]
    res=[]
    for R0,R1 in zip(rr,rr[1:]):
        for C0,C1 in zip(cc_,cc_[1:]):
            acc=Counter(g[i][j] for i in range(R0,R1) for j in range(C0,C1) if i not in sr and j not in sc)
            nonbg=[(v,c) for v,c in acc.items() if v!=bg]
            if nonbg:
                main=max(nonbg,key=lambda x:x[1])[0]
                S=set((i-R0,j-C0) for i in range(R0,R1) for j in range(C0,C1) if g[i][j]==main and i not in sr and j not in sc)
                res.append((R0,R1,C0,C1,main,S))
            else:
                res.append((R0,R1,C0,C1,None,set()))
    return res

for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    I=G[name+' input']; O=G[name+' output']
    bg,sr,sc=geom(I)
    # accent cells overall (non-bg, non-sep)
    acells=[(i,j) for i in range(len(I)) for j in range(len(I[0])) if I[i][j] not in (bg,) and I[i][j]!=I[sr[0]][0] if i not in sr and j not in sc]
    colc=Counter(j for _,j in acells); rowc=Counter(i for i,_ in acells)
    print(name,'bg',bg,'sep',I[sr[0]][0],'max col count',max(colc.values()) if colc else 0,'max row count',max(rowc.values()) if rowc else 0)
    for b in blocks(I):
        R0,R1,C0,C1,m,S=b
        if not m: continue

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def bands(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); cntv=Counter(v for row in g for v in row); bg=cntv.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sr=sorted(i for i in range(H) if len(set(g[i]))==1); sc=sorted(j for j in range(W) if len({g[i][j] for i in range(H)})==1)
    Rb=[0]+sr+[H]; Cb=[0]+sc+[W]
    B=[]
    for R0,R1 in zip(Rb,Rb[1:]):
        for C0,C1 in zip(Cb,Cb[1:]):
            ints=[(i,j) for i in range(R0,R1) for j in range(C0,C1) if i not in sr and j not in sc]
            acc=Counter(g[i][j] for i,j in ints)
            nb={v:c for v,c in acc.items() if v!=bg}
            main=max(nb,key=lambda v:nb[v]) if nb else None; n=nb[main] if nb else 0
            S={(i,j) for i,j in ints if g[i][j]==main}
            out=G[g['__name__'] if False else 'test']( ) 
            B.append((R0,R1,C0,C1,main,n,len(S)))
    return B,bg
